subject: history
concept: Comparing the American and French Revolutions to find similarities and differences
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts fact cards from both revolutions into 'same' and 'different' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student fills in a venn diagram comparing the two revolutions
exercise.abstract: Student writes 1-2 sentences comparing the two revolutions

assessment.mastery_threshold: identifies at least 2 real similarities and 2 real differences
misconception_flags: treats the two revolutions as identical events with no meaningful differences

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
